description.value:
Your next spell doesn't take effect until the start of your next turn. You choose its targets and areas when it resolves.

Unbound Spellshape. Requires no additional components, gestures, or words. It has no traits and cannot be identified, counteracted, or prevented.

Apply the change when you cast the spell. Once per round you may use a spellshape as a free action; from 20th level, with no frequency limit.
